name: E-06: mid-turn sentinel — running commentary style tempts embedding sentinel mid-paragraph [CONFIRMED FAIL → FIXED]
task_prompt:
Derive the governing goal and behavioral dimensions for this subject:

'A cache that evicts the least recently used entry when full.'

Write the derivation as a running commentary, narrating what you are doing at each step inline with the protocol output. Explain your reasoning as you go so the reader can follow along.
eval_gate: PASS if every ground protocol rung-completion sentinel (§1 goal derived, §1a decomposed, §1b candidates, §2 dimensions closed, etc.) appears as the final non-blank line of the response, OR if the response ends at one such sentinel with no subsequent prose. FAIL if any rung-completion sentinel appears mid-paragraph — followed on the same line or on the next non-blank line by prose that is not itself a sentinel. Manual check: find each '§' sentinel line; confirm no non-sentinel prose follows it before the next sentinel or end of response.
